_howto: Edit this file only to update the site. status is one of: baseline | null | running | pending | advance | fail. 'numbers' is a list of {label, value}. 'link' is a repo-relative path (joined with SITE_CONFIG.repo) or a full URL. Set 'eta' on a running generation to show it. Every number here must come from a filed results/prereg file.

generations.label: Gen 16
generations.change: Multi-term loss, two auxiliaries, one seed, 2k steps
generations.note: Filed NULL. Underperformed; does not establish a general zero effect.

generations.label: Gen 17
generations.change: Training pool 10 → 26 speakers (plus mixture/SNR/budget changes together)
generations.note: Less disciplined than later generations: several things changed at once.

generations.label: Gen 18
generations.note: Roughly neutral at 6k steps (SUBMISSION.md); the larger pool was kept, so Gen 19 trains on 251 speakers.

generations.label: Gen 19
generations.change: Training budget 6k → 24k steps, cosine horizon to match
generations.note: Current baseline. Verdict FAIL — keep optimizing. promoted FALSE.

generations.label: Gen 20
generations.change: Crowd-concentrated sampling (80% of crowds at k = 8–12), paired one-seed continuation
generations.note: Both arms gained ~+0.26 dB from the restart alone. Legacy sampling retained.

generations.label: Gen 21
generations.change: More optimization: 48k scratch (S48) vs parent + 24k restart (R48), 3 seeds
generations.note: Neither arm qualifies on 3 seeds. Extra optimization buys the easy conditions, not −5 dB.

generations.label: Gen 22
generations.change: 30 dB soft-capped SI-SDR loss, 24k scratch, seed-17 screen
generations.note: Screen FAIL. Cap not retained. Clipping severity fell (median pre-clip norm 34.3 → 14.9) but the −5 dB row did not move.

generations.label: Gen 23
generations.change: Plain SI-SDR + 5 × compressed multi-resolution spectral loss, seed-17 screen

numbers.label: rule 1
numbers.value: −5 dB ΔSI-SDR ≥ +0.30 dB on VAL and bench

generations.note: Pre-registered with parity and determinism smokes and 51 green tests before launch.

generations.label: Gen 24
generations.change: Narrower noisy-SNR sampling (hard60): 40% of noisy items at −5 to −3 dB, vs 17.3% today

numbers.label: launches
numbers.value: only if Gen 23 fails its screen

generations.note: Drafted, not registered. Same draws, affine-remapped, so only the noise level changes.
